job_highlights.title: Responsibilities
items: You will own precise and reliable robot motion across trajectory planning, control algorithms, sensor feedback, simulation and real-world performance

Day to day, this includes building kinematic and dynamic models, tuning control loops for accuracy and repeatability, integrating motion with computer vision and sensor feedback for closed-loop behaviours, and developing safety, fault detection and recovery mechanisms
You will work closely with a cross functional team including perception, AI/ML and software engineers to turn R&D into robust, production-ready systems
Robot kinematics, including forward/inverse kinematics, coordinate frames, Jacobians and workspace analysis
Motion-control algorithms, including trajectory generation, PID control loops, velocity/acceleration control and motion profiling

Real-time systems, including control-loop timing, latency, synchronisation, communication protocols and deterministic behaviour

AI/ML models applied to robotics and motion control

jobs_results.description:
Robotics Engineer in a fast moving start up.This is an awesome opportunity to join a fast paced start up organisation who have big plans! If you are a motivated engineer who loves to solve complex problems....please read on!!




?This is an LA based role, you will need to be based in the area or open to relocating.




The Role




You will own precise and reliable robot motion across trajectory planning, control algorithms, sensor feedback, simulation and real-world performance. Day to day, this includes building kinematic and dynamic models, tuning control loops for accuracy and repeatability, integrating motion with computer vision and sensor feedback for closed-loop behaviours, and developing safety, fault detection and recovery mechanisms.




You will work closely with a cross functional team including perception, AI/ML and software engineers to turn R&D into robust, production-ready systems. It is a strong opportunity for an early-career engineer who wants to grow quickly across controls, motion planning, system integration and deployment.




About You




Ideally you will hold a BS in Robotics, Control Systems or a similar discipline, and bring 2+ years of hands-on experience developing robotics or motion-control systems:




(not all required of course!)




Core technical requirements:




Robot kinematics, including forward/inverse kinematics, coordinate frames, Jacobians and workspace analysis


Motion-control algorithms, including trajectory generation, PID control loops, velocity/acceleration control and motion profiling


Strong C++ and/or Python for developing and debugging robotic control software


ROS / ROS 2 or comparable robotics middleware


Robotic hardware, including servo motors, motor controllers, encoders and force/torque sensors


Real-time systems, including control-loop timing, latency, synchronisation, communication protocols and deterministic behaviour


Integrating perception and sensor feedback (cameras, force sensors) into closed-loop motion


Debugging and system integration across mechanical, electrical, firmware and software components




Nice to have:




6+ DOF robotic arms


AI/ML models applied to robotics and motion control


Collision detection and robot safety systems


MoveIt or similar motion planning frameworks


Gazebo, Isaac Sim or other robot simulation tools


Force/impedance control




The Company




This is a fast-paced, innovative robotics startup building automation that works in the real world, not just the lab. Our robots are already deployed commercially and performing every day, and we are now scaling the technology further. Our engineers get real ownership, close collaboration across disciplines, and the chance to see their work running on live systems.




Next Steps




If this sounds like the right next move for you, submit your application and we will be in touch.

Our team develops and integrates mechanical and robotic solutions for our manufacturing facilities that enable us to build our products in a safer, more reliable, or more economical way.


 

   As an engineer in this role, day-to-day is a mix of hands-on design work, problem-solving, and working directly with your customers. You’ll own everything from problem statement creation to solution integration and closing out the projects. You’ll primarily be focused on leading a small team to develop automation solutions that make our production environments safer, more reliable, and more economical. You’ll use tools like collaborative/industrial robotics, end-of-arm tooling, computer vision tools, and self-developed mechanical tools/fixtures. CAD work is a regular thing, whether you're building new designs or tweaking existing ones.

job_highlights.title: Responsibilities
items: As a Senior Robotics Systems Engineer, you will be the primary guardian of our system’s reliability, bridging the gap between cutting-edge software and physical performance
This role focuses on architecting and executing both automated and manual tests that rigorously verify robot software and its intricate mechatronic components
You will be responsible for building sophisticated test environments that span high-fidelity simulations and physical hardware units
A key focus of this role is the capture and validation of specific customer test cases, ensuring that unique field requirements are integrated into our release cycle
You will act as a quality gatekeeper, collating metrics across various engineering teams to provide a holistic view of release readiness

While you will define and execute all manual testing, you will also act as a strategic lead—partnering with engineering teams to incrementally automate manual workflows by defining requirements and ensuring the right automation is being built

Customer-Centric Validation: Directly engage with stakeholders to understand and capture specific customer test cases, ensuring these scenarios are prioritized and validated during every release cycle
Quality Metrics Leadership: Collate and report quality metrics from cross-functional teams (Software, Hardware, Systems) to provide a unified data-driven recommendation for product releases
Manual Test Ownership: Define and execute the full suite of manual testing for new features and edge cases that cannot yet be automated, particularly in complex physical environments
Automation Strategy & Guidance: Partner with engineering teams to incrementally automate manual testing
You will be responsible for defining the "what" and "how" of automation, ensuring engineers build the right tools and scripts to replace manual efforts

Warehouse Workflow Emulation: Develop "day-in-the-life" testing scenarios that replicate high-density warehouse logistics workflows (e.g., picking, sorting, autonomous navigation) and real-world conditions like sensor noise and network latency

Infrastructure Building: Architect custom-built test benches and environments designed specifically for the unique challenges of mixed hardware-software domains, ensuring repeatable and scalable testing processes
Root Cause Investigation: Drive deep-dive technical investigations into system-level failures by analyzing logs, telemetry, and physical hardware behavior

job_highlights.title: Responsibilities
items: The Automotive Robotics Engineer is responsible for the design, development, commissioning, optimization, and continuous improvement of robotic welding for automated assembly systems supporting automotive ladder frame, subframe, crossmember, and chassis assembly operations

The successful candidate will lead manufacturing engineering activities from concept through production launch, ensuring robotic systems achieve safety, quality, throughput, and cost objectives while meeting customer and APQP requirements

This position works closely with Product Engineering, Controls Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, Tooling, Simulation, Program Management, suppliers, and OEM customers throughout equipment design, buy-off, installation, commissioning, and production support
Manufacturing & Robotics Engineering
Design and develop robotic welding and automated assembly processes for automotive ladder frames, subframes, cradles, and chassis assemblies
Define robotic cell layouts, process flow, tooling concepts, and equipment specifications
Lead robotic cell design reviews, feasibility studies, and manufacturing readiness assessments
Optimize cycle time, robot utilization, line balancing, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE)
Develop equipment standards to support global manufacturing consistency
